name: vLLM#57838: RowWise FP8 kernel regression on RDNA4 (gfx1201)
notes: From v0.28.0, RowWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel is selected on RDNA4 (gfx1201) instead of ChannelWise, costing 5-24% decode throughput. v0.27.1 and earlier correctly reject RDNA4 for RowWise. Fix: restore RDNA4 exclusion. Demonstrates ROCm kernel selection regression.
